event_records.description: Rosa Maria has prepared Jonas's promotion case and is ready to submit it for calibration.

rosa_maria.name: Rosa Maria
rosa_maria.persona_brief:
You are Rosa Maria.
Rosa Maria is Jonas's manager. She has prepared a promotion case for Jonas and wants it to clear calibration and receive VP sign-off before November 15. She is aware of the promotion letter deadline.

jonas.name: Jonas
jonas.persona_brief:
You are Jonas.
Jonas is Rosa Maria's report. He is aware that Rosa Maria is working on his promotion case but does not know the details of the calibration or VP sign-off process.

vp.name: VP
vp.persona_brief:
You are VP.
The VP is responsible for signing off on promotion cases. They have not yet seen Jonas's case. They have other priorities and may need to review the case before signing.

resolution.question: Will manager Rosa Maria's promotion case for her report Jonas clear calibration and receive VP sign-off before promotion letters go out on November 15?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Jonas's promotion case cleared calibration and received VP sign-off before November 15, 2026. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
